source_text:
9.8 Καὶ ὁ Κύριος εἰς τὸν
αἰῶνα μένει, ἡτοίμασεν ἐν κρίσει τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ. Οὐ μόνον κατὰ τὸν παρόντα
βίον τὴν οἰκείαν δύναμιν ε δειξεν, ἀλλὰ κα ν τῷ μέλ λοντι τὸ φρικῶδες αὐτοῦ
δείξει κριτήριον πᾶσιν ἀνθρώποις, δικάζων, καὶ τὰ πρὸς ἀξίαν ἀπονέμων ἑκάστῳ.
pass_a_gloss: And the Lord into the age remains, he-prepared in judgment the throne of-him. Not only according-to the present life the own power he-showed, but also in-the coming the fearful of-him he-will-show tribunal to-all men, judging, and the toward desert assigning to-each.
pass_b_english: “And the Lord remains forever; he prepared his throne in judgment” (Psalm 9:8).
Not only in the present life did he show his own power, but also in the coming one he will show his fearful tribunal to all men, judging and assigning to each what is according to desert.

choices.why: Coming-age judgment seat, not a present-life court only. φρικῶδες = fearful/awe-inspiring.

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
